question: At the cap-112 ceiling, does an admission rule that guarantees the rank-1-20 core and the rank-21-40 band recover every core+band edge without a false-admission rate more than 10 percentage points worse than the normal cap-112 window?

design.pairing: each seed's world and stimulus are identical in both arms
design.treatment: the same cap-112 run, with every top-20 core and rank-21-40 band transition guaranteed a served seat; a missing tier edge replaces the lowest-priority non-tier transition, then a cooccurrence if no transition remains
design.tier: core is transition rank 1-20 in the cycle's full pre-cap universe; band is rank 21-40 in that same universe
design.window: the engine's served list remains 112 rows; treatment only replaces seats

coverage.metric: served tier edges / available tier edges, pooled over cycles and seeds

false_admission.metric: served rows whose edge is not a present world transition, divided by all served rows; treatment minus control
false_admission.unit: pooled by summing rows, per seed reported; a 10,000-resample seed-cluster bootstrap gives the upper bound

endpoints.binding: a replacement in any treatment cycle; if none occurs and the window digests match, the rule is non-binding at 112

gates.C1_build: one 0.15.0 build and cap 112 across all cells
gates.C2_world: each seed has the same world digest in both arms
gates.C3_tier: each cycle has 40 tier edges when the pre-cap universe has at least 40 transitions
gates.C5_ledger: every tier edge is accounted for as served or missing
gates.C6_control: control is the unmodified repaired observer
gates.C7_treatment: treatment differs only by the tier guarantee

decision_table.condition: a gate fails or a window is short
decision_table.reading: the block did not produce a readable window
decision_table.decision: fix the ledger; do not read coverage

decision_table.condition: gates pass, no replacement, all window digests equal
decision_table.reading: the normal cap-112 window already serves every core+band edge
decision_table.decision: do not add a separate admission rule at this ceiling

decision_table.condition: gates pass, replacements occur, coverage >= 0.95 and false-admission difference <= +0.10
decision_table.reading: the guarantee changes the window and preserves the cost bar
decision_table.decision: consider the rule only with its measured cost

decision_table.reading: the guarantee did not recover the tier
decision_table.decision: do not adopt; inspect the missing ledger

decision_table.condition: gates pass, replacements occur, false-admission difference > +0.10
decision_table.reading: the guarantee recovers the tier by serving more non-world rows
decision_table.decision: do not adopt on coverage alone; report the trade

authorisation.quote: Preregister and run the core+band admission rule on a fresh six-seed block with a cap-112 ceiling.
authorisation.note: The owner's instruction is the grant for these twelve cells.

not_evidence: A twelve-cell test of one admission guarantee on one synthetic world family. It does not establish capability, retention, transfer or a general operating cap.
